❄️ Brrr… the winter chill is rolling through the neighborhood, but your love for PvZ: Replanted has kept our hearts toasty, especially during the Steam Awards nominations! As Feastivus approaches, we’re delivering a fresh bundle of cheer with Patch 1.5.0 rolling out on 12/10, and here’s what’s wrapped inside.
PVZ: Replanted: Patch v1.5.0
Added Survival: Endless Day, Night, Fog, Roof, and Cloudy Day levels.
These Endless levels each have their own save slots, with existing Survival: Endless saves carried over to Survival: Endless (Pool).
Fixed crash most commonly seen in long Survival: Endless games
Fixed cases where explosive plants (Cherry Bomb, Jalapeno, etc.) could get stuck in levels after using them
Fixed loading issue caused by interrupting the flow around Dave’s Taco after level 4-4 (The Magic Taco needed some attunement to account for speedsters)
Fixed issues with P2 planting cards in Vasebreaker levels
Fixed being able to use the Wheelbarrow to bring seedlings into the Aquarium
Fixed Zombies Plant Daisies visual toggle not properly retaining its state after exiting levels
Fixed issue with menus getting stuck when controller disconnects happened with the I, Zombie game over message on screen
Fixed Seed Select menu music starting a few seconds into the track (The record had some dust. It’s cleaned now, so no more skipping!)
Fixed Conveyor plant preview blackouts (Dr.Z was up to no good once again)
Muted ingame sfx during the title scene when starting a new Adventure run
Fixed issues with Zombies appearing in the Seed Select Preview view with visual toggles enabled
Fixed Aquarium planting slot shadows not being visible when using the Glove or Wheelbarrow
Fixed Zombotany head appearance issues
Fixed Cherry Bomb growing animation stopping early
Made sure Dr. Zomboss’s arm is properly attached when he throws the RV at the bottom row (Dr. Z is re-armed and dangerous!)
Feels like Feastivus!
Peashooter, Wall-nut, Regular Zombie, and Conehead Zombie are all feeling particularly feastive this month🧣
Thank you for your continued support and for showing your love for PvZ: Replanted! Have a great Feastivus, and we’ll see you back on the lawn (all bundled up and cozy).

Hey there, lawn legends! We hope you’ve been enjoying defending the lawn with the sweet tunes introduced in our last patch. Thanks to your invaluable feedback, we're rolling out another exciting new update on 11/18 that will leaf you smiling! This update features Steam Remote Play Together and new accessibility options, making lawn defense more inclusive. Essential gameplay fixes are also included, which you can dig into below:
PVZ: Replanted: Patch v1.4.0
\ Remote Play Together is now supported! This Steam feature allows you to play our local multiplayer (Co-op and Vs.) with your friends online, as if you were in the same room.
The same limitations of 2-player local multiplayer apply. Player 2 is required to use a controller

Steam allows up to 4 people to connect to a Remote Play Together stream. We recommend limiting the enabled input devices (via the Steam Overlay Remote Play settings) to just allow 2 active players, as that is the maximum the game supports
Please note also that this Steam feature relies on the host player's internet connection speed for game stream performance and stability
Added Accessibility Features that can be toggled on via the Main Menu Options Menu:
High Contrast Mode (high contrast visuals during gameplay to accommodate visual accessibility needs)
Slow Speed (changes 1x speed to 0.5x game speed and reduces the faster speeds accordingly)
Disable Screenshake (removes shaking effect on explosions and other areas)
Added Sun Vacuum / Magnet function to the game

Pressing Right Trigger/R2/ZR on Controllers or Spacebar on Keyboard activates the sun vacuum function, collecting all individual suns present in the level when activated. (Now you can spend more time on strategizing & execution instead of staring at the suns. Which we’ve heard isn’t good for your eyes)
Added additional Keyboard Hotkeys
Tab cycles game speed
1-0 number keys selects and deselects Seed Packets during gameplay
Spacebar activates Sun Vacuum
Added ability to open the Almanac from the Pause Menu
Fixed Main Menu button not appearing on Reward Screen
Optimizations made for Zombie memory management to improve performance on lower end devices, particularly in Survival Endless.
Fixed Sol Invictus achievement not being awarded at exactly 2000 sun
Fixed Gold Sunflower trophy not showing on the Main Menu for players who already had Nobel Peas Prize unlocked before an earlier fix for this issue
Fixed issues with Life Well Lived achievement unlock conditions incorrectly tracking used lawnmowers
Fixed Co-op Streak Counter and Trophy unlocks not showing correctly
Vasebreaker and I, Zombie Minigames now have separate save slots
Fixed Fog covering the Zombie preview during Seed Selection on Survival levels (We don’t like surprises on this lawn)
Fixes for Endless modes not showing streak counter/flags completed properly
Fixed Polevaulters being a little too effective at getting past lawnmowers in rare cases (Took a while, but we’ve shortened all the poles we could find)
Fixed Mallet becoming unusable in certain situations during Vasebreaker levels
Fixes for reported issues with Cob Cannon causing freezes in levels
Fixes for various issues with Garden Tools and Zen Garden navigation
Fixes for issues with plant selection and timer resets
Zomboni now properly spawns Bobsled Team in Vs Mode.
Many more minor optimizations, fixes and polish changes
Reduced volume of the RIP Mode guitar riff (Dr. Z has been issued a sound complaint by the neighborhood watch)
Fixed various audio and visual issues with the Almanac including Zombie Sprite Sheet using incorrect placeholder assets
Fix for Plant/Zombie placement previews not being faded out when you can't afford to place them
Marigolds now show their whole range of colours
Fixed Dave forgetting to show you various items when he's talking about them (Dave got too excited but he’s got enough practice now)
Fixed Dave wandering a bit too far off-screen in certain aspect ratios (We’ve marked his spot with tape so he knows where to stand now)
Fixed audio and visual issues with the Vs. Mode Target Zombies
Fixed various visual states not showing correctly in Vs. Mode
Fixed lawnmowers flying into position
Fixed alternate lawnmower wheels going into overdrive
Fixed Retro Zombie's Rubber Ducky appearance
Fixed various Zombie layering issues
Fixed Plant/Seed Packet outline inconsistencies
Various Plant and Zombie animation, sfx and vfx fixes
Fixes for minor Zen Garden visual issues
Minor font sizing fixes
Many more minor optimizations, fixes and polish changes
Harder???
Thanks for helping us nurture Replanted! With the holidays right around the corner, it's the perfect time to get back on the lawn. We can’t wait to see all your strategies, shenanigans, and stories!

items.text: It’s been about a week since Replanted’s launch and we’ve been thrilled to see all the new and old strategies that have been blossoming on the lawn. Since then we’ve also been hard at work implementing the feedback that you’ve shared with us. Which is why we’re happy to announce that the classic and plantastic Dynamic Audio is now in the game with this update alongside more fixes and tweaks! This update goes live on 11/3.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45721213/b2d3537b219c949553c3e4a6d55c6efd41d26cf1.png"]
PVZ: Replanted: Patch v1.3.0
○ Added Dynamic Audio to the level music so it no longer always plays at the highest intensity version (perfect time for a blindfolded run)
○ Minigame, Puzzle, Survival and Almanac menus now play the correct music instead of the previous menu's music
○ Sound effects no longer overlap menu music at higher game speeds
○ Added missing menu open SFX for Pause Menu
○ Collecting Sun has a wider range of audio played
○ \[Vs Mode] Plant and Zombie tooltips now properly appear when using controllers during match selection
○ Retro Zombies no longer unexpectedly jump or teleport ahead during movement (Dr. Zomboss got us good with this one)
○ Disabling Vsync no longer impacts Mouse cursor speed
○ Fixed plants showing incorrectly when collecting sun while dragging them to be placed with Touch inputs
○ Dr. Zomboss no longer signs his notes with a comma after his name (We wonder if Tugboat was forging those notes for him)
○ Various text string fixes
○ Cards are hidden properly after Planterns are eaten in Vasebreaker
○ Fixed various visual issues with Magnet-Shroom grabbing items
○ Fixed a few Controller prompts showing incorrectly when not using controllers for input
○ Flags now raise properly when reached on the Level Progress bar
○ Fixed Conveyor Belt sizing to show all 10 slots

Just like every garden, there’s still some more work to be done. Patch V1.4.0 is close to being done which will add the ability to collect sun with the squeeze of a trigger on controllers and aim to get rid of some more pesky bugs among other things! Expect this patch to go live within the next two weeks with more details of the next patch being shared closer to its release. So stay tuned and once again, thanks for your support, feedback, and patience! Now let’s get back on the lawn and listen to those sweet tunes!
Plants vs. Zombies™: Replanted on Steam

It’s been great to see all the lawns being defended globally since lawnch! We’re hard at work addressing your feedback and wanted to share with you our week one patch. This update includes several fixes and goes live today 10/29. Detailed list below.
Fixed an image resolution on the "You got a new plant!" screens
Fixed Retro Zombie’s detached parts to no longer appear blurry.
Fixed various issues with hover and click state appearances.
Fixed Tree Food not appearing when Crazy Dave introduces the Tree of Wisdom. Just don’t ask us how a Tree…eats.
Fixed an issue with Digger Zombie effect layering in Fog layers.
Fixed an issue where Plant Pots had faces when they really shouldn't.
Fixed Cob Cannon to no longer appear visually once removed with a shovel in certain situations. Get outta here Corn!
Fixed various animation cycling issues.
Fixed an issue that prevented plants from being used when held by Player one while Player two places a zombie.
Crazy Dave no longer preselects Peashooter every time in Adventure+
Fixed an issue that prevented plants from being used when held while activating Cob Cannon with certain input types.
D-Pad directional input is now continuous instead of requiring individual presses.
Peashooter sounds will now fire the proper amount in battle.
Fixed loading problems related to launching with Steam Overlay disabled or Steam in Offline Mode.
Fixed various minor text string issues.
Cursor no longer hides when attempting to scroll the Cheats menu before unlocking all options.
You can no longer accidentally access other screens while in the Almanac
Removed Imitater from the Zombie Almanac. Sneaky, sneaky.
The Wake Stinky the Snail banner no longer causes input issues

We aren’t done yet though! Patch V1.3.0 is wrapping up in development as we speak and brings Dynamic Audio and several other audio based improvements to the game, as well additional bug squashing. We expect to see this future patch go live within a week. Stay tuned for a detailed update of the next patch as we get closer to release and thanks again for all your support and feedback, now lets get back to the Lawn!
